clue.text: Bus pranged in pound is okay

indicators.note: the jumbled bus sits inside the word for pound

parts.note: to pound something is to thump it

explanation.surface: A bus has crashed into a vehicle pound, and somebody insists it is all fine.

explanation.definitionFit: Giving something the thumbs-up is a gesture of approval, so the phrase works as a noun meaning approval or the go-ahead.
